overridesNotes.esbuild: GHSA-g7r4-m6w7-qqqr: require the patched Windows development server. This deliberately exceeds Vite 6's ^0.25.0 and tsx's ^0.27 ranges; retain bundler integration tests on Node 22/24. Vitest 4 supports the existing Vite 6 override.
overridesNotes.fast-uri: Dependabot #94-97: fast-uri >=3.1.6 fixes URI canonicalization and host-confusion SSRF advisories, within ajv's ^3.0.1 range.
overridesNotes.browserslist: Dependabot #92-93: >=4.28.7 fixes custom-stats prototype writes, crashes and unbounded cache growth; remains on major 4.
overridesNotes.baseline-browser-mapping: GHSA-w5vr-8v7q-w6rv: >=2.11.0 rejects invalid input without terminating the process.
overridesNotes.js-yaml: GHSA-5p4m-2wfm-xmqj and GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh: patched floors for both supported majors, preserving the Changesets v3 safeLoad API and v4 consumers.
overridesNotes.undici: Require >=6.28.0 on major 6 for cookie/header injection and retry desynchronization fixes. Docs AI SDK 6 patches remove undici 5; do not downgrade the separate major 7/8 consumers. Overrides cannot replace dependencies vendored inside Eve.
overridesNotes.nanoid: GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8: require >=3.3.18 for major 3 consumers such as PostCSS, retaining their CommonJS support without changing major 5 consumers.
overridesNotes.postcss: Retain >=8.5.23 for prior PostCSS security fixes. Next 16.3.3 now pins 8.5.23 itself; this floor also covers other consumers.
overridesNotes.sharp: GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c: >=0.35.4 ships patched libheif. Next 16.3.3 permits ^0.35.3; retain the security floor and the existing 0.35-series override for the Next 15 example.
